blockbuilder-explorer.visual_critic_note: Cohesive dark theme with a thoughtful CSS variable system and multi-panel layout shows design intent, but the 6px gaps and edge-to-edge packing leave the dashboard feeling cramped rather than breathable, and the network graph's dense blue node-link tangle reads more as visual noise than insight at rendered size.
blockbuilder-explorer.encoding_integrity_note: Correct scaleSqrt for circle area and zero-baseline bar chart, but the network dynamically re-scales node radii on filter (subset relation violated) and no key functions guard data joins against object-constancy bugs.
blockbuilder-explorer.stress_test_note: Dirty-flag + RAF coalescing pattern is correctly implemented for all brush and click events; no transitions to interrupt, pointer events API prevents mouse/touch fights, and no circular dispatch exists, but list and thumb-wall updaters do full innerHTML teardown/rebuild (up to 200 and 500 nodes respectively) on every filter change, which is an unthrottled bulk DOM mutation inside the RAF frame.
blockbuilder-explorer.cognitive_load_note: 4 linked views with clear panel labels and a pre-settled force layout (400 ticks, no live reheat) keep the dashboard manageable, but the 60-node network is visually dense with overlapping edges and no visible cluster separation, making API co-occurrence structure hard to extract at a glance.
